obligations.description: Output completed packets in allocation order starting from external tag0; a later tag that completes first is still blocked by an incomplete head packet. There is no output backpressure; low-order DWs are output first, with at most 4 DWs per cycle and the remaining 1..4 DWs on the final cycle. The low 4 bits of the mapped route are the channel, and groups 0/1/2 correspond to MAIN/SG_RX/SG_TX respectively; only route0..11, 16..27, and 32..43 map to public count vectors; other 6-bit routes are legal but have no public routing activity. Only the low 32*count bits of ENG_DATA for the corresponding count are defined. If the head packet's final input edge is n, an idle output unit can output no earlier than edge n+10; the first beat of a subsequent completed packet must be no earlier than its own n+10, and no earlier than 2 edges after the preceding packet's final beat (if the preceding packet is no more than 4 DWs) or 1 edge after it (if the preceding packet exceeds 4 DWs); output is continuous on every edge within a packet.

Invisible routes likewise consume and clear their packets and must not block subsequent visible routes.
